lines.en: label christmastwo16:
scene clearnightsky
I make my way through an empty lobby and out into the open air.
lines.zh: 我穿过空荡荡的大堂，走到外面的露天里。

lines.en: It’s not every day that I go to the effort of seeking someone out for the sole purpose of doing something nice for them, but...{i}tis the season{/i} or whatever else you’re supposed to say here.
lines.zh: 我可不是每天都会为了“单纯为某人做件好事”而费劲去找人，不过……{i}应景嘛{/i}，或者这种时候该说的随便什么话。

lines.en: What a life I lead where I must justify acts of kindness with seasonal phrases at the risk of seeming a little more human to whoever or whatever is watching me at all hours of the day.
lines.zh: 我过的是什么人生啊，居然得用季节性的套话来给善行找理由，就为了在那些日夜盯着我的、不知是人是物的东西面前显得稍微更像个人一点。

lines.en: Or night now, I suppose.
lines.zh: 或者说，现在是夜里了。

lines.en: Which isn’t to say that someone {i}is{/i} watching me.
lines.zh: 倒不是说{i}真的{/i}有谁在看着我。

lines.en: I’m no more paranoid than anyone else.
lines.zh: 我不比别人更疑神疑鬼。

lines.en: But, in the event that one of thousands of religions might have sturdy enough hands to grab hold of the elusive truths of the world- I will remain careful.
lines.zh: 不过，万一在成千上万种宗教里，真有一双足够有力的手，能抓住这世界那些难以捉摸的真相——我还是会保持谨慎。

lines.en: I will remain vigilant.
lines.zh: 我会保持警惕。

lines.en: Because those elusive truths would imply that there is more to simply being than {i}being.{/i}
lines.zh: 因为那些难以捉摸的真相意味着，{i}“存在”{/i}之外还有更多的东西。

lines.en: I will walk into the night with a purpose in every step, keeping close to the walls to avoid the prying eyes of imaginary (Or unimaginary) gods.
lines.zh: 我会带着每一步的目的走进夜色，紧贴着墙走，避开那些想象的（或者不那么想象的）神明的窥视。

lines.en: Or...anyone else who might see me alone with a small girl in the middle of the night.
lines.zh: 或者……避开任何可能看到我在深夜和一个小女孩独处的人。

lines.en: I’m sure I look incredibly suspicious right now.
lines.zh: 我敢肯定我现在的样子可疑极了。

lines.en: But I’m an incredibly suspicious person, so that’s rightfully deserved.
lines.zh: 但我本来就是个极其可疑的人，所以这是应得的。

lines.en: I look down at the stuffed bear in my hands and wonder why it was that I picked this of all things.
lines.zh: 我低头看着手里那只毛绒熊，不明白自己为什么偏偏挑了这个。

lines.en: Was this {i}really{/i} just a spur of the moment decision brought on by an overwhelming lack of care?
lines.zh: 这{i}真的{/i}只是一时冲动、因为极度不在乎才做出的决定吗？

lines.en: Or is there something more to it?
lines.zh: 还是说，这里面有更深的东西？

lines.en: I search my mind for the answer but am unable to sneak past an ever-growing wall of apathy thirty one years in the making.
lines.zh: 我在脑海里寻找答案，却始终翻不过那堵不断增高的、建造了三十一年的冷漠之墙。

lines.en: To think it’s been in construction for so long and is not even close to finished is a bit disheartening.
lines.zh: 想想它已经建了这么久却还远未完工，多少让人沮丧。

lines.en: And while I should hate that such an obstacle exists at all, especially in the place where it does-
lines.zh: 虽然我该憎恨这堵障碍的存在，尤其是它所在的位置——

lines.en: All I’m really curious about is whether or not I’ll live to see it completed.
lines.zh: 但我真正好奇的，只是我能不能活到看见它建成的那一天。

lines.en: What a wonderful wall it will be.
lines.zh: 那将会是一堵多么美妙的墙。

lines.en: Oh, right.
lines.zh: 哦，对了。

lines.en: The bear.
lines.zh: 熊。

lines.en: I need to give this to Miku.
lines.zh: 我得把这个交给 Miku。

lines.en: scene black
My legs begin to tremble for reasons beyond my comprehension.
lines.zh: 我的双腿开始颤抖，原因我无法理解。

lines.en: The glow of electric billboards dyes my clothes.
lines.zh: 电子广告牌的光晕染上了我的衣服。

lines.en: I revel in the light, yet move further into the dark in hopes of pulling out a girl drenched in it.
lines.zh: 我沉醉在这光里，却又向更深的黑暗走去，希望能把那个浸在黑暗里的女孩拉出来。

lines.en: scene help5
scene mikubear1
if chikalust10 == True:
I find her on a familiar bench in a familiar place.
lines.zh: 我在一个熟悉的地方、一条熟悉的长椅上找到了她。

lines.en: else:
I find her easily.
lines.zh: 我很容易就找到了她。

lines.en: She does not notice my presence at first, for I am just one more shadow in a world filled to the brim with them.
lines.zh: 她一开始没有注意到我的存在，因为在这个挤满了阴影的世界里，我不过是又一个影子。

lines.en: I do not exist until she accepts my existence.
lines.zh: 在她接受我的存在之前，我并不存在。

lines.en: And I make no sound because there are no sounds left to make.
lines.zh: 而我不发出任何声音，因为已经没有声音可以发出了。

lines.en: scene help5
scene mikubear2
Her shirt comes off, but only in my mind.
lines.zh: 她的上衣脱了下来，不过只在我的脑海里。

lines.en: I’m sure that things are different outside of it.
lines.zh: 我确信在脑海之外，事情是不一样的。

lines.en: They always are.
lines.zh: 一向如此。

lines.en: As I {s}sit{/s} stand and stare at the budding chest of the school’s star soccer player, I struggle to subconsciously slide off her pants.
lines.zh: 我站着凝视着这位学校明星足球员刚开始发育的胸部，同时在潜意识里挣扎着，想把她的裤子褪下来。

lines.en: How shameful that even the images I conjure up are incapable of giving me more than I already have.
lines.zh: 真是可耻，连我自己想象出来的画面，都没法给我比我已有的更多的东西。

lines.en: Or had.
lines.zh: 或者曾有过的。

lines.en: Or will have.
lines.zh: 或者将有的。

lines.en: Or am currently having.
lines.zh: 或者正在有的。

lines.en: Or possessed at one point only to be pushed back to the beginning.
lines.zh: 或者曾经拥有、却被打回起点的。

lines.en: But for what?
lines.zh: 可那是为了什么？

lines.en: The sensation of flower petals falling off of my fingertips infuriates me.
lines.zh: 花瓣从我指尖滑落的感觉让我恼火。

lines.en: I long to return to the memory of this young girl, nervously grinding up against my-
lines.zh: 我渴望回到那个夜晚的记忆里——那个年轻女孩紧张地在我身上磨蹭着——

lines.en: scene help5
scene mikubear1
No.
lines.zh: 不。

lines.en: That’s not why I-
lines.zh: 我不是为这个才——

lines.en: scene help5
scene mikubear2
I wonder how often she thinks of that night.
lines.zh: 我在想，她有多常想起那个夜晚。

lines.en: I bet it’s more than I do.
lines.zh: 我打赌比我想的次数多。

lines.en: scene mikubear3
: Hm?
: Sensei?
lines.zh: : 老师？

lines.en: scene mikubear4
: Hey.
: What’re you doin’ out here? Figured you’d be fist deep in a whole room full of girls by now.
lines.zh: : 你在这儿干什么？我还以为你这会儿已经在一整屋的女生里忙得不可开交了呢。

lines.en: : I think you might be misunderstanding the usage of “fist deep” seeing as I only have two of them and could not possibly-
lines.zh: : 我觉得你可能误解了“忙得不可开交”的用法，毕竟我只有两只手，不可能——

lines.en: : Actually, that doesn’t matter. I’m here to see you.
lines.zh: : 算了，这不重要。我是来找你的。

lines.en: scene mikubear5
: Me? But...Wait, did Makoto tell you I was here?
lines.zh: : 我？可是……等等，是 Makoto 告诉你我在这儿的吗？

lines.en: : Was she not supposed to do that?
lines.zh: : 她不该说吗？

lines.en: scene mikubear6
: Well, I...didn’t tell her not to tell ya. I just think there are a lot better ways of spendin’ your Christmas than worrying about me.
lines.zh: : 嗯，我……也没叫她别说。我只是觉得，你的圣诞节有比担心我好得多的过法。

lines.en: : I’ll go back up soon. Just needed a little break from all of the noise.
lines.zh: : 我很快就回去了。只是需要远离那些噪音，喘口气。

lines.en: : Turns out I wasn't doin' as good as I thought I was.
lines.zh: : 结果我发现自己没有我以为的那么扛得住。

lines.en: : Can only handle so much at once, ya know?
lines.zh: : 一次只能应付这么多，你懂吧？

lines.en: : Don’t worry about rushing to go back up there. Almost half of the class is missing at this point, so it’s not like you’re the odd man out or anything.
lines.zh: : 别急着赶回楼上。这会儿班上差不多有一半人都不在了，所以你也不算那个落单的。

lines.en: scene mikubear7
: Yeah, I noticed that. And Kirin left without even sayin’ bye to me. D’ya think havin’ so many people in our class now is like...separatin’ everybody into factions or something?
lines.zh: : 是啊，我注意到了。而且 Kirin 连再见都没跟我说就走了。你说，我们班现在人这么多，是不是有点像……把大家分成了各个阵营什么的？

lines.en: : No, but I wouldn’t be surprised if the two day long event where you all literally separated into factions did that.
lines.zh: : 不，不过要是那场为期两天、你们真的分成阵营的活动造成了这种结果，我也不会惊讶。

lines.en: scene mikubear8
: Don’t bring that up. I’m still embarrassed about how my part of the contest ended up.
lines.zh: : 别提那个。我对自己那部分比赛的结局还是很不好意思。

lines.en: : You...won, though?
lines.zh: : 可你……赢了啊？

lines.en: scene mikubear5
: But at what cost?! It wasn’t a sweep {i}and{/i} I got licked by a girl! It may as well have just been a flat out loss.
lines.zh: : 但代价是什么？！又不是横扫，{i}而且{/i}我还被一个女生舔了！那跟干脆输掉没什么两样。

lines.en: : Then...make up for it next time. I don’t know.
lines.zh: : 那……下次补回来呗。我也不知道。

lines.en: scene mikubear9
: You feelin’ okay, Sensei? You look fine but you seem a little more...{i}blah{/i} than usual.
lines.zh: : 你还好吗，老师？你看着没事，但好像比平时更……{i}蔫{/i}。

lines.en: : Anything your buddy Miku can do to perk you up a bit?
lines.zh: : 你的好哥们儿 Miku 能帮你振作点吗？

lines.en: : Nothing legal.
lines.zh: : 合法范围内没有。

lines.en: : Legal? You tryin’ to rob a bank or something?
lines.zh: : 合法？你是打算去抢银行还是怎么的？

lines.en: : Yup. That is exactly what I was implying.
lines.zh: : 对。我暗示的正是这个。

lines.en: : Then take a seat and draft up some heist plans with me. I had to use up the last of my money buyin’ a present for Io so I’m basically flat out broke.
lines.zh: : 那坐下，跟我一起策划几起劫案。我把最后一点钱都花在给 Io 买礼物上了，所以基本是彻底破产了。

lines.en: : You had to get something for Io? What did you buy?
lines.zh: : 你得给 Io 买东西？你买了什么？

lines.en: scene mikubear10
: Hehehe...I ain’t tellin’ you. You’ll just have to see it for yourself the next time you visit her room.
lines.zh: : 嘿嘿嘿……我才不告诉你。等你下次去她房间自己看吧。

lines.en: : Now, come on. Tell me more about this heist. Me and you’ll be the best bank robbers Kumon-mi’s ever seen.
lines.zh: : 好了，快点。再跟我说说这起劫案。我和你将成为 Kumon-mi 有史以来最厉害的银行劫匪。

lines.en: scene black
Miku slides over on the bench and makes room for me.
lines.zh: Miku 在长椅上挪了挪，给我腾出位置。

lines.en: I awkwardly place the stuffed bear in my lap and have to choke back vomit as it causes me to imagine a life in which it is replaced by a child.
lines.zh: 我笨拙地把毛绒熊放在腿上，因为它让我想象起它被一个孩子取代的人生，我不得不把涌上来的呕吐感咽回去。

lines.en: And while I’m sure the image of that would make several girls I know very, {i}very{/i} happy- it makes me feel sick.
lines.zh: 虽然我确信那个画面会让我认识的几个女生非常{i}非常{/i}开心——但它让我觉得恶心。

lines.en: scene mikubear11
: I ain’t gonna lie to you, Sensei...you look pretty friggin’ creepy right now. Kinda like some...baby thief or something.
lines.zh: : 我就不骗你了，老师……你现在看着真他妈的瘆人。有点像那种……偷婴儿的什么的。

lines.en: : I’m glad that at least you acknowledge that I would be a horrible father. That means a lot.
lines.zh: : 我很高兴至少你承认我会是个糟糕的父亲。这对我意义重大。

lines.en: : Wasn’t really tryin’ to compliment you, but I’m glad I could help.
lines.zh: : 我也不是在夸你，不过能帮上忙就好。

lines.en: : What’re ya carryin’ that thing around for anyway? I wasn’t gonna say anything at first, but now that it’s in your lap, I kinda can’t ignore it anymore.
lines.zh: : 话说你抱着那玩意儿干嘛？一开始我还不想说，可现在它就在你腿上，我想装看不见都不行了。

lines.en: scene mikubear12
: Wait, isn’t that the same bear Touka was luggin’ around earlier? She give that to you or something?
lines.zh: : 等等，那不是 Touka 之前一直抱着的那只熊吗？她给你的还是怎么着？

lines.en: : I know ya told me I wasn't supposed to look at her, but I kinda failed at that right away.
lines.zh: : 我知道你跟我说过别看她，但我一下就失败了。

lines.en: : Pretty crappy present if ya ask me.
lines.zh: : 要我说，这礼物挺烂的。

lines.en: : Well, that is going to make the next few minutes very awkward because {i}I{/i} actually bought this for you.
lines.zh: : 嗯，那接下来的几分钟会非常尴尬，因为这其实是{i}我{/i}买给你的。

lines.en: scene mikubear13
: No. No you didn’t. That’s...
lines.zh: : 不。你没有。那是……

lines.en: scene mikubear14
: That’s not something that...
lines.zh: : 那不是那种……

lines.en: : Because...I’m...
Guess I should have just added another piece to her soccer ball collection after all.
lines.zh: 看来我当初真该再给她添一个足球才对。

lines.en: : If you’re worried about upsetting me, don’t be. It’s fine to dislike it.
lines.zh: : 如果你担心会惹我不高兴，别担心。不喜欢也没关系。

lines.en: : I kind of just bought it on a whim anyway, so it’s not like there was any real thought put into it.
lines.zh: : 反正我也是一时兴起买的，所以也没花什么心思。

lines.en: : You bought...{i}that{/i} on a whim...for me?
lines.zh: : 你……一时兴起……给我买了{i}那个{/i}？

lines.en: scene mikubear15
: You’re just pullin’ my leg, right? You probably bought that for Ami or Uta or somethin’ and are just messin’ around right now.
lines.zh: : 你在耍我吧？你八成是买给 Ami 或者 Uta 什么的，现在故意逗我玩。

lines.en: : Why would I be messing around?
lines.zh: : 我为什么要逗你玩？

lines.en: scene mikubear16
: Because that’s definitely not the kinda thing I’d expect ya to buy for me when you can get some kinda...sports thingy at pretty much any store you walk into!
lines.zh: : 因为那种东西我绝对想不到你会买给我啊！你随便走进哪家店都能买到某种……运动用品之类的！

lines.en: : I don’t have anything that...girly! I just don’t keep that kind of stuff around! So you’d have no reason to choose that over somethin’ more...Miku-ish.
lines.zh: : 我又没有那么……女孩子气的东西！我家里根本不摆那种玩意儿！所以你没理由选它，而不是更……Miku 一点的东西。

lines.en: : Well, it’s yours now. So if you want to pretend it’s a basketball and just shoot it into the trash can behind us, we can do that.
lines.zh: : 好吧，它现在是你的了。所以如果你想把它当成篮球、投进我们身后那个垃圾桶，我们可以这么干。

lines.en: : I get to go first, though, because I used my money to buy it and that would only be fair.
lines.zh: : 不过我得先来，因为是我花钱买的，这样才公平。

lines.en: : What? No...I...
lines.zh: : 什么？不……我……

lines.en: scene mikubear17
Miku snatches the bear out of my hands and stares at it for a few moments.
lines.zh: Miku 一把从我手里抢过熊，盯着它看了好一会儿。

lines.en: I recall a short while ago when Makoto mentioned something about Miku going to the place “furthest away from the noise” or however it was she worded it-
lines.zh: 我想起不久前 Makoto 说过 Miku 会去“离噪音最远的地方”，或者她原话是怎么说的——

lines.en: But the lack of conversation, as temporary as it may be, makes me acutely aware that there is no escape at all.
lines.zh: 但这份沉默，哪怕只是暂时的，也让我敏锐地意识到：根本无处可逃。

lines.en: And that even in this place, as far away from her fears as possible, they’re still lingering in the background.
lines.zh: 而即便是在这个地方，在她尽可能远离恐惧的地方，它们依然在背景里徘徊。

lines.en: As is everything in a world full of shadows.
lines.zh: 就像这个满是阴影的世界里的一切一样。

lines.en: : So, remember when you said {i}I{/i} was creepy a couple minutes ago? You’re really not making a good case for yourself by just silently staring at a toy right now.
lines.zh: : 话说，你几分钟前说{i}我{/i}瘆人的时候还记得吗？你现在就这么一声不吭地盯着一个玩具看，可完全没给自己加分。

lines.en: : Oh no...
lines.zh: : 不好了……

lines.en: scene mikubear18
: Miku?
lines.zh: : Miku？

lines.en: : No no no no no no...this is bad.
lines.zh: : 不不不不不不……这下糟了。

lines.en: : This is really, really bad.
lines.zh: : 真的、真的糟透了。

lines.en: : Wow. You must really hate bears.
lines.zh: : 哇。你一定恨透了熊。

lines.en: scene mikubear19
: This is the single worst thing you could have gotten me...
lines.zh: : 这是你能送给我的最糟糕的东西了……

lines.en: : Yeah, you’ve made that pretty apparent.
lines.zh: : 是啊，你说得够明白了。

lines.en: : No...Sensei...You don’t understand...
lines.zh: : 不……老师……你不明白……

lines.en: : I love it...
lines.zh: : 我好喜欢它……

lines.en: : You’re right. I don’t understand.
lines.zh: : 你说得对。我不明白。

lines.en: scene mikubear20
: I love it so much! I...I need to give him a name!
lines.zh: : 我太喜欢它了！我……我得给它取个名字！

lines.en: : You really don’t-
lines.zh: : 你真的不用——

lines.en: : I do!
lines.zh: : 我要！

lines.en: : And...
lines.zh: : 而且……

lines.en: scene mikubear21
: I’m sorry!
lines.zh: : 对不起！

lines.en: : Sorry for-
lines.zh: : 为什么对不——

lines.en: scene help5
scene mikubear22
: Mm~
lines.zh: : Mm~

lines.en: Oh. Okay.
lines.zh: 哦。好吧。

lines.en: I get it now.
lines.zh: 我现在明白了。

lines.en: It’s {i}exactly{/i} what she wanted.
lines.zh: 这{i}正是{/i}她想要的东西。

lines.en: Perhaps there {i}was{/i} a reason I bought this after all.
lines.zh: 也许我买这个确实{i}是{/i}有原因的。

lines.en: And perhaps things simply stop being {i}whims{/i} when you’ve existed long enough to experience every outcome.
lines.zh: 也许当你存在得够久、经历过每一种结果之后，事情就不再只是{i}一时兴起{/i}。

lines.en: Is this a new path?
lines.zh: 这是一条新的路吗？

lines.en: Or am I just sticking as close to someone else’s shadow as I possibly can?
lines.zh: 还是说，我只是尽可能紧地贴着别人的影子走？

lines.en: There’s obviously no point in thinking about that right now, though.
lines.zh: 不过，现在想这些显然没有意义。

lines.en: Not when I can do this.
lines.zh: 当我能做这个的时候，就没有意义。

lines.en: scene mikubear23
: Mm! Mm...mnh...mm...
lines.zh: : Mm! Mm...mnh...mm...

lines.en: : Chu...mm~
lines.zh: : Chu...mm~

lines.en: : Thank you...mnch...thank...you...
lines.zh: : 谢谢……mnch……谢谢……你……

lines.en: : Sensei...
lines.zh: : 老师……

lines.en: Miku clumsily kisses me back and clearly has no idea what she’s doing.
lines.zh: Miku 笨拙地回吻我，显然完全不知道自己在做什么。

lines.en: She likes it, though.
lines.zh: 不过她喜欢。

lines.en: Which, all things considered, I’m not that surprised about.
lines.zh: 考虑到种种情况，我对此并不太惊讶。

lines.en: I’ve obviously known for a while that she’s been interested in me on at least {i}some{/i} level.
lines.zh: 我显然早就知道她至少在{i}某种{/i}程度上对我有意思。

lines.en: I just figured that level was going to remain a bit more dubious until she came to terms with pining after the man her best friend loves.
lines.zh: 我只是以为，在她接受“自己迷恋上了闺蜜喜欢的男人”这件事之前，那种程度会一直保持在比较暧昧的状态。

lines.en: That’s why this present was so horrible.
lines.zh: 所以这份礼物才糟糕透顶。

lines.en: Because it’s jeopardizing one of the purest, truest friendships I have ever known.
lines.zh: 因为它在危及我所见过的最纯粹、最真挚的一段友谊。

lines.en: And it’s doing so in a way much more calculated than drowsily grinding against my cock in the middle of the night.
lines.zh: 而且它这么做的方式，比半夜迷迷糊糊地在我鸡巴上磨蹭要精心得多。

lines.en: {i}This{/i} is something we meant to do.
lines.zh: {i}这{/i}是我们本就打算做的事。

lines.en: No. This is something {i}Miku{/i} meant to do.
lines.zh: 不。这是 {i}Miku{/i} 本就打算做的事。

lines.en: She can’t hide anymore.
lines.zh: 她再也藏不住了。

lines.en: There truly is no escape.
lines.zh: 真的无处可逃。

lines.en: scene mikubear24
: {i}Haah...{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}Haah...{/i}

lines.en: : I have to tell Makoto...
lines.zh: : 我得告诉 Makoto……

lines.en: : Why?
lines.zh: : 为什么？

lines.en: : Because she loves you...
lines.zh: : 因为她爱你……

lines.en: : Makoto must know how you feel about me by now.
lines.zh: : Makoto 现在肯定已经知道你对我的感觉了。

lines.en: : I don't know, Sensei. She did bust into the room that one time, but...
lines.zh: : 我不知道，老师。她是有一次闯进过房间，不过……

lines.en: : But I told her it didn't mean anything. I {i}promised{/i} her it didn't mean anything.
lines.zh: : 但我告诉她那不算什么。我向她{i}保证{/i}那不算什么。

lines.en: : Stop suffering for her.
lines.zh: : 别再为她受苦了。

lines.en: : It’s not {i}suffering{/i}, Sensei. If she’s happy, I’m happy.
lines.zh: : 这不是{i}受苦{/i}，老师。她幸福，我就幸福。

lines.en: : Then shouldn’t the same go for her?
lines.zh: : 那她不也该一样吗？

lines.en: scene mikubear25
: What do you mean?...
lines.zh: : 你是什么意思？……

lines.en: : If being with me makes {i}you{/i} happy, shouldn’t {i}she{/i} be happy knowing that you are?
lines.zh: : 如果和我在一起让{i}你{/i}幸福，那{i}她{/i}知道你幸福，不也该为你高兴吗？

lines.en: : She’s liked you forever. I can’t just cut the line no matter {i}how{/i} much I want to.
lines.zh: : 她喜欢你那么久了。不管我{i}多{/i}想，我也没法就这么插队啊。

lines.en: : But you can blur it.
lines.zh: : 但你可以把那条线模糊掉。

lines.en: : You’ve gotta remember who you’re talkin’ to right now, Sensei. I ain’t good at pickin’ up on fancy metaphors like that.
lines.zh: : 老师，你得记住你现在在跟谁说话。我可不擅长领会那种文绉绉的比喻。

lines.en: : That...{i}was{/i} a metaphor, right?
lines.zh: : 那……{i}是{/i}个比喻，对吧？

lines.en: : Just keep this a secret. You don’t {i}have{/i} to tell Makoto everything because there’s no way {i}she’s{/i} telling you everything.
lines.zh: : 就保密吧。你{i}不用{/i}什么都告诉 Makoto，因为{i}她{/i}也不见得什么都告诉你。

lines.en: scene mikubear26
: She does, though...
lines.zh: : 她告诉的……

lines.en: : But that’s not sayin’ I like hearin’ it...It’s really hard sometimes, you know?...
lines.zh: : 但我不是说我喜欢听……有时候真的很难，你懂吗？……

lines.en: : I’m happy that she gets to...do all sorts of stuff with you...but it makes me feel all...gross inside hearin’ about it...
lines.zh: : 她能和你……做各种各样的事，我是高兴的……可听到那些，我心里就觉得……怪恶心的……

lines.en: : And your solution is to just keep letting that happen?
lines.zh: : 而你的解决办法就是继续让这种事发生？

lines.en: : I told you already...I’m on Team Makoto...
lines.zh: : 我说过了……我是 Makoto 队的……

lines.en: : I can’t be-
lines.zh: : 我不能——

lines.en: scene mikubear23
: Mmm! Mm...
lines.zh: : Mmm! Mm...

lines.en: : I...can’t be...mnch...doing this...
lines.zh: : 我……不能……mnch……这么做……

lines.en: : It’s bad...it’s...really...really...bad...
lines.zh: : 这很糟……这……真的……真的……很糟……

lines.en: scene mikubear27
: You seem to be enjoying this quite a bit for someone who allegedly doesn’t want it.
lines.zh: : 对一个嘴上说着不想要的人，你看起来倒是挺享受的。

lines.en: : I doubt {i}you’re{/i} havin’ any fun, though. I’ve got no friggin’ idea what to do with my tongue. I’m still new to this.
lines.zh: : 不过我怀疑{i}你{/i}也没什么乐趣。我完全他妈的不知道舌头该怎么放。我还是新手。

lines.en: : That’s fine. We can practice.
lines.zh: : 没关系。我们可以练。

lines.en: : I’ve gotta tell her, Sensei...
lines.zh: : 我得告诉她，老师……

lines.en: : You don’t.
lines.zh: : 你不用。

lines.en: : I do...
lines.zh: : 我要……

lines.en: : You don’t.
lines.zh: : 你不用。

lines.en: : I do. Every time I look at that bear, it’s gonna remind me of this.
lines.zh: : 我要。以后每次看到那只熊，它都会让我想起这件事。

lines.en: : Then get rid of the bear.
lines.zh: : 那就把熊扔了。

lines.en: scene mikubear28
: You kidding?! No way! This is the first time anyone’s ever given me somethin’ like that! And it was friggin’ {i}you{/i} of all people.
lines.zh: : 你开玩笑？！想得美！这可是第一次有人送我这样的东西！而且居然是{i}你{/i}送的。

lines.en: : I’m gonna treasure it forever!
lines.zh: : 我要一辈子珍藏它！

lines.en: : Then don’t complain about how it makes you feel when you look at it.
lines.zh: : 那就别抱怨看着它的时候心里是什么感受。

lines.en: : Accept what happened here tonight and take solace in the fact that the person you’re interested in is interested in you.
lines.zh: : 接受今晚在这里发生的事吧，并且从“你在意的人也在意你”这件事上得到安慰。

lines.en: : Makoto doesn’t need to know that. No one does.
lines.zh: : Makoto 不需要知道这个。谁都不需要。

lines.en: scene mikubear24
: Sensei...thank you again for the present, but...
lines.zh: : 老师……再次谢谢你的礼物，不过……

lines.en: : I kinda...think I need a little time to myself to...figure out what to do.
lines.zh: : 我……大概……需要一点独处的时间，来……想清楚该怎么办。

lines.en: : I’m assuming that means we’re done making out then?
lines.zh: : 我猜这意味着我们到此为止了？

lines.en: : I guess so...
lines.zh: : 大概是吧……

lines.en: : Sorry again for attacking you like that...
lines.zh: : 再次抱歉就这么扑上去了……

lines.en: : You can attack me as often as you want so long as we’re not in public.
lines.zh: : 只要不是在公共场合，你想扑我多少次都行。

lines.en: : Stop sayin’ such...dangerous things, Sensei...
lines.zh: : 别再说这么……危险的话了，老师……

lines.en: : It’ll only make it harder for me...
lines.zh: : 那只会让我更难受……

lines.en: scene black
Miku and I break apart.
lines.zh: Miku 和我分开。

lines.en: But she breaks a little bit more.
lines.zh: 但她裂开得更多一点。

lines.zh: {i}欢迎来到 Lessons in Love！{/i}

lines.zh: {i}一款让你把阴茎放进那些带着创伤的女生体内的游戏，不管她们觉得这是多糟的主意！{/i}

lines.zh: {i}偶尔，你的行为会导致这样的事情发生。{/i}

lines.zh: {i}但没关系！因为大多数时候，这甚至不是你的错。{/i}

lines.zh: {i}毕竟，你是一道影子。{/i}

lines.zh: {i}你正是我想要你成为的一切。{/i}

lines.en: {i}And slowly, but surely, you are becoming even more.{/i}
lines.zh: {i}而慢慢地、确凿地，你正在变得更甚于此。{/i}

lines.en: {i}There is something buried underneath your feet.{/i}
lines.zh: {i}有什么东西埋在你的脚下。{/i}

lines.en: {i}And something above as well.{/i}
lines.zh: {i}也有什么东西在你的上方。{/i}
